test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 23rd November 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

In the jungle, he saw a ______________ of wolves.
solution:
The correct answer is "**Pack**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The correct sentence would be:
 
 
• In the jungle, he saw a ***pack*** of wolves.
 
 
 
• ​A ***collective noun*** is a noun that denotes a particular group or collective—of individuals, creatures, objects, etc.
 
• Even if they relate to a ***group of things***, collective nouns are typically not considered as plural.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• A ***bunch ***of keys.
 
• ***Grove*** of trees.
 
• ***Herd*** of sheep.
